name: Mnemonic Sentinel
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
description:
The mnemonic sentinel is a tall, ritual-crafted construct built to guard memory as fiercely as treasure. Its body is assembled from pale stone plates, lacquered bronze ribs, and inset memory-slates that glow with dim script whenever it stirs. A faceless, polished mask crowns its head, but the surface is never still: fleeting reflections of intruders, old ward sigils, and half-remembered scenes drift across it like images trapped beneath ice. Thin lens-like eyes rotate behind the mask, clicking softly as they compare the present to some forgotten ideal.

It moves with measured, ceremonial precision, each step accompanied by the whisper of sliding wards and the faint chime of chained keys. When alerted, runes along its arms and chest flare in orderly bands, projecting ghostly fragments of stolen recollections into the air to confuse, judge, or identify trespassers. Its hands end in careful, archivist-like fingers, but they can lock into spear-point shapes for defense. The sentinel's presence chills the chamber around it, as if the room itself is trying to remember what was once meant to be protected. It is less a warrior than a living oath, patient and relentless, standing watch over sealed truths in silence.
